metadata.tool_mechanism: Two free dynamic lever halves, the original opening-spring hinge, and two passive normal-axis pad slides. Only robot finger contact closes the tool.
metadata.jaw_gap_definition: Measured inner pad-face separation along the current lower-pad normal; includes both actual passive pad compressions.
draft_assumptions: 150 g overlap-counted compound tool; engine-derived inertia.
Opening spring, damping, friction and contact compliance are draft fixture values.
MuJoCo contact success does not establish PhysX/YAM transfer, wafer stress limits or cleanroom suitability.

The0.2Nms/rad hinge damper is an explicit unmeasured mechanical draft; the spring/rest/0.3Nm native cap are unchanged. Saved actual q/qdot must keep the unconstrained SI torque within0.3Nm before any native clipping.
Each pad mass includes its backing assembly; uniform effective inertia is a draft approximation.
Pad-mount stiffness and damping are explicit shared draft assumptions, not measured hardware data; non-pad lever masses are proportionally redistributed to preserve each original half total.
Uncoupled mode diagnostics do not establish stability of coupled wafer contacts.
Native8N spring caps exceed the declared q/qdot envelope; the prospective accepted unconstrained spring force remains limited to4N and pad speed to0.05m/s.
Explicit SI mount springs are shared across engines; remaining rigid-contact constraint/compliance and friction algorithms are still not equivalent.
Fresh actual YAM arm begins prealigned; 20 Hz position targets and MuJoCo body gravity compensation are not validated PhysX equivalents.

wafer_collision_partition.mass_distribution: Explicit original uniform-solid inertia; overlapping collision geoms carry zero additional mass.
wafer_collision_partition.representation: Continuous front cap under both pads; overlap only at the rear partition edge.

unchanged: Passive hinge spring, limits and friction
changed: Four side guides taper to backing at both X entry ends
retention_candidate.topology: Two free dynamic lever halves connected only by the original passive hinge; no additional actuator or attachment.
retention_candidate.entry: Convex eight-vertex guide prisms; no vertical end wall, overhang or undercut. Flat central guide length20mm.
retention_candidate.tradeoff: Less lateral/yaw constraint near guide ends; broad central stops retained. Normal-contact reactions and retention require physical testing.
retention_candidate.end_rib_mass_rule: Removed rib mass retained in its broad handle; COM/inertia recomputed.

numerical_timing.scope: Shared mechanical draft and integration cadence; original wafer acceptance retained.

metadata.pad_compliance_scope: Two passive normal-axis springs with constant zero rest. No independent closing actuator, commanded pad motion or wafer attachment.
metadata.candidate_scope: Shared compliant mechanical draft; local validation precedes cloud transfer.

retention_disturbance.application: World-frame force and torque at the free lower-half center of mass.
retention_disturbance.scope: Separate development sensitivity only; never part of the five baseline cases.

metadata.initial_condition: Both hands empty; passive pliers rest on a separate stand, wafer rests on three pillars.
metadata.robot_gravity_compensation: MuJoCo per-body gravity compensation; not a verified match to Isaac motor dynamics.
metadata.actuator_force_scope: Robot arm torque is saved separately in Nm; finger and powered-jaw forces are separate named N arrays.

profile.checked_at: Every physics sample after the violating measurement has been saved
profile.consequence: Stop the new v2 trial immediately and retain FAILED evidence
profile.scope: Prospective simulation jam diagnostic only; not a hardware load rating or change to wafer criteria.

finger_handle_jam_guard.measurement_scope: Per-finger sum of individual intended-handle/rib/guide normal-force magnitudes.

passive_pad_guard.checked_at: Every physics sample after the violating measurement has been saved
passive_pad_guard.scope: Passive-mechanism diagnostic for the shared declared pad profile; native8N cap remains separate from4N diagnostic, not a hardware rating or change to wafer acceptance criteria.

passive_hinge_guard.checked_at: Every saved physics sample, using actual joint velocity
passive_hinge_guard.scope: Prospective mechanical-damper diagnostic; unchanged0.3Nm native cap, not calibrated hardware torque or a relaxed wafer criterion.

full_workflow_timing_profile.scope: Full workflow only; unchanged measured readiness and physical limits.

cycle_layout.handle_remap: Opposite-side grip; mirrored lateral guides and rear stop. Passive jaws unchanged.

clamp_cradle.function: Passive support under the hinge during open-jaw settling; no joint or attachment.

gun.scope: Unmeasured low-mass mechanical draft; passive trigger, no attachment or hose forces.

full_cycle_handle_geometry.mass_rule: Lateral-guide mass redistributed into each physical broad handle; COM and inertia recomputed.
full_cycle_handle_geometry.sizing: Connected edge and axial shoulders locate the fingers. Each paddle retains 10 g distributed by physical volume.
full_cycle_handle_geometry.topology: Two unpowered pitch hinges on physical handle paddles; robot fingers provide all squeezing force.

handle_paddle_capacity_profile.numerical_drive_cap: 100 mNm prevents clipping the full-range linear spring; accepted raw torque remains at most 60 mNm. Historical specifications without an operating guard use their authored force cap.
handle_paddle_capacity_profile.rationale: A 20 g wafer about 150 mm ahead of the grip contributes about 29.5 mNm gravity moment. The 25 mNm diagnostic is below this ordinary load; the accepted operating torque limit is 60 mNm. Contact, retention and task checks remain independent.

local_contact_solver_profile.scope: Restores the numerical settings of the completed v12 pickup and 150-second loaded hold. Geometry, friction coefficients, springs, actuator limits and timestep are unchanged; PhysX retains its own solver.

timing_profile.scope: Faster clear-space motion; the original final three seconds of finger closure are unchanged.

tool_pickup.stage_clock: Global physics time is continuous; handoff uses a declared stage-local clock.

insertion_sweep.scope: Conservative wafer-frame AABBs for straight translation with current hinge and orientation; actual motion remains contact-guarded.

wafer_stage_docking.target_tolerance_scope: Native float32 target representation only; no motion/contact tolerance changes.

result.scope: Recorded contact-held passive pliers; no motorized jaw or attachment.

insertion_clearance.scope: Conservative wafer-frame AABBs for straight translation with current hinge and orientation; actual motion remains contact-guarded.

native_fingertip_geometry_diagnostic.scope: MuJoCo with recorded native convex surfaces for both hands; not PhysX.

tool_hand_retention_profile.reference: Last tool_grip_hold sample; retained through docking, wafer grasp and gun return
tool_hand_retention_profile.position: Midpoint of the two measured contacting paddle centers
tool_hand_retention_profile.orientation: Each actual contacting paddle relative to the hand; lever rotation is diagnostic

wafer_support_force_measurement.source: MuJoCo contact-frame normal forces; geom2 positive and geom1 negative.

task_qualification.legacy_warning_effect: Diagnostic only; actual joint, speed and drive-cap bounds remain mandatory.

task_integrity_profile.source: Compiled model definitions checked against the time-zero scene on every recorded physics sample.
task_integrity_profile.scope: Geometry/topology/configuration integrity; no material fracture model.

tcp_feedback_handoff.scope: Initialize controller memory from measured handoff; no robot state, clock or acceptance bounds change.

controller.initial_condition: Measured state after physical tool pickup and passive docking.

profile.contact_latch: Either pad triggers one retained latch for all subsequent active phases, including contact dropouts.
profile.sensor_scope: Exact completed preceding physics interval; mean positive K*q, full-interval static/dynamic peaks, and wafer-to-pad forces. K*q is not contact-force calibration; tracking lag is not measured actuator force.
profile.physical_scope: Draft measured-preload controller. No internal jaw drive, attachment, actuator-cap increase or acceptance-threshold change.

jaw_plane_feedback.scope: Measured jaw pose controls arm targets; fixed initial wafer plane and continuous nominal lift. No tool attachment or jaw actuation.

replay.scope: Continuous measured state from empty hands; no pose resets.

native_mechanical_revision.name: passive_opening_045_wide_handle_lands
native_mechanical_revision.reason: Reduce opening resistance with wider handle lands; unchanged finger force limits.

handle_contact_compliance.scope: Draft elastic handle lining; 5 N corresponds to 0.1 mm static indentation per contact. Not calibrated hardware.

docking_hold_controller.scope: Hold the last arm command once aligned; resume on measured drift. Controller targets remain distinct from the clearance readiness check.

native_mechanical_revision.alignment: Measured open-jaw clearance governs docking readiness; centering error remains diagnostic.
native_mechanical_revision.retention_frame: Actual finger-contact paddles; unchanged instantaneous 2 mm / 3 deg limits.
native_mechanical_revision.acceptance_change_scope: User-authorized open-jaw clearance readiness replaces exact normal centering; physical grip, retention and collision limits remain unchanged. Future runs only. Whole-wafer stillness is diagnostic; secure retained lifting and placement remain required.
native_mechanical_revision.stationary_hold_controller: After one second on target, latch arm targets; resume correction if measured jaw error exceeds 1.5 mm or 0.75 degrees. Acceptance limits unchanged.
native_mechanical_revision.evaluation_optimization: Use existing compact evaluator fields for the prefix; complete recorded trace and all checks retained.

native_solver_contact_order.scope: Native PGS solver comparison; unchanged geometry, friction, drives, timestep and acceptance.

docking_acceptance_change.authorization: User requested successful pickup and holding without unnecessary precision on 2026-11-11.
docking_acceptance_change.center_and_full_3d_error: Diagnostic only; measured face and housing clearance governs wafer-normal readiness.
docking_acceptance_change.retained: Bilateral contact, pickup, load, collision, wafer retention, hold and return checks.
docking_acceptance_change.historical_results: Unchanged; this policy applies to future runs.

hold_acceptance.scope: Whole-wafer stillness is diagnostic. Lift height, pillar clearance, tilt, jaw engagement, bilateral contact, relative slip, release and stable placement remain acceptance criteria.
hold_acceptance.historical_results: Unchanged; applies only to future runs.

particle_scan.scope: No-roll sweep with retimed transport; spray, contact, force, retention and scoring limits unchanged.

gun_seating_controller.retreat: Backward/upward after release; preserve the previous final parked pose.
gun_seating_controller.reason: Acquire support load, settle, then withdraw downward while opening to clear the gun body; force/travel bounds unchanged.

gun_settling_acceptance.placement_basis: 60 mm stand with required 2 mm footprint margin; wafer centering remains 1 mm.
gun_settling_acceptance.raw_velocity: Diagnostic only; every measured pose in the existing hold window is checked.
gun_settling_acceptance.retained: Absolute placement, orientation, support load, support margin, contact, release, air-off and free-standing checks.
gun_settling_acceptance.historical_results: Unchanged; prospective controller and evaluation revision.

native_mechanical_revision.gun_support_handoff: Recognize measured stand support during unilateral finger contact; final release, trigger-off and free-standing requirements remain unchanged.
native_mechanical_revision.online_gun_retention_guard: Stop on the existing 1.5 mm or 2 degree retention limits before intentional release; original scored limits unchanged.
native_mechanical_revision.evaluation_storage: Reuse compact prefix fields and a bounded 256-block stage cache; every physics sample and acceptance check is retained.
native_mechanical_revision.particle_contact_classification: Filter all 12 named particles on each tool body. Permit these identified contacts only after air starts; preserve unknown/fixture/gun contact guards and final all-clear requirement.
native_mechanical_revision.particle_completion_order: Require all particles clear for one second before wafer lowering starts, and clear at task end. Removal caused only by placing the wafer cannot pass.

scope: Development configuration derived from historical V28; no local pass for this spring or the particles.
